title: from_f64_with_unit/from_f32_with_unit return 0 bytes for tiny positive sizes instead of rounding up
property: A positive size is rounded up to at least 1 byte, and from_f64_with_unit(x, Unit::B) equals from_f64(x)
evidence: Docs: 'The calculated byte will be rounded up.' from_f64 documents 'The fractional part will be rounded up' and returns 1 for 1e-29. The Decimal conversion (Decimal::from_f64) silently flattens values below 1e-28 to zero before the ceil.
